summary: Calidi Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing the issuance of a warrant to purchase up to 17,391,304 unvested shares of common stock at $0.23 per share to an accredited investor in a private placement under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). The warrant is first exercisable on September 8, 2026, and vests proportionally if the holder acquires up to $4.0 million of common stock in registered issuances before July 8, 2026; neither party is obligated to consummate those issuances. This is a routine equity-linked financing, not a special situation. No deal terms or change-of-control implications exist.
